newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK long-end govt paper yields up in line with U.S..
newsitem.headline: HK long-end govt paper yields up in line with U.S..

text.p: Hong Kong long-end government paper yields stood higher on Tuesday in line with overnight rises in U.S. Treasury yields, dealers said.
Yields of seven-year Exchange Fund notes firmed to 7.54 percent from 7.51 at Monday's midsession.
Five-year notes yielded 7.21 percent versus 7.18 percent, and three-year notes yielded 6.58 percent versus 6.50.
Yields of one-week Exchange Fund bills were more stable, at 5.07 percent versus 5.05.
Activity was quiet, said a local bank dealer.
